articles.title: Move Over, T. rex — There's a New King in Town, and It Swam!
articles.summary: Scientists just discovered a giant sea monster called Tylosaurus rex. It was as long as a school bus and had teeth like steak knives. A fossil nicknamed 'The Black Knight' shows it survived a broken jaw and kept hunting.

articles.title: Mars: Not Just a Red Ball — It's a World of Surprises!
articles.summary: Mars isn't totally red — it has browns, golds, and even green flecks! If you stood on the equator at noon, your toes would feel toasty but your face would freeze. And summer lasts six months, but so does winter!

articles.title: Australia: The Land of Kangaroos, Giant Rocks, and Deadly Spiders!
articles.summary: Australia is a continent and a country! It has the world's largest rock, Uluru, and animals found nowhere else, like kangaroos and platypuses. But watch out — it's also home to 36 kinds of poisonous spiders!
